definitions.explanation: A container used to store or carry chopsticks. Comes in various forms — from decorative wooden boxes for home use to portable plastic cases for packed lunches.

examples.japanese: {箸箱|はしばこ}から{箸|はし}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I took the chopsticks out of the case.

examples.japanese: お{弁当用|べんとうよう}の{箸箱|はしばこ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a chopstick case for my lunch box.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{箸箱|はしばこ}を{学校|がっこう}に{忘|わす}れてきたので、{明日|あした}{使|つか}う{分|ぶん}がない。
examples.english: My child left the chopstick case at school, so there isn't one to use tomorrow.

notes:
USAGE:
{箸箱|はしばこ} is a compound of {箸|はし} (chopsticks) and {箱|はこ} (box). In Japan, many people carry reusable chopsticks in a case as part of their lunch set. Traditional wooden {箸箱|はしばこ} are also used as tableware at home.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箸箱|はしばこ}セット (chopstick case set — often includes spoon/fork)
- {弁当|べんとう}の{箸箱|はしばこ} (lunch box chopstick case)
- {木製|もくせい}の{箸箱|はしばこ} (wooden chopstick case)
